Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 133, "var": "data/size", "code": "htsFile *ht_file = hts_hopen(memfile, \"data\", \"rb\");", "note": "The 207-byte attacker-controlled CRAM input is copied into a memory hFILE and passed to hts_hopen, which detects the CRAM format and opens it for reading."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "hts.c", "function": "hts_hopen", "line": 1173, "var": "fp->fp.cram", "code": "fp->fp.cram = cram_dopen(hfile, fn, simple_mode);", "note": "Format detection classifies the input as CRAM, so hts_hopen dispatches to cram_dopen, passing the attacker-controlled hFILE."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "cram/cram_io.c", "function": "cram_dopen", "line": 5153, "var": "fd->header", "code": "if (!(fd->header = cram_read_SAM_hdr(fd)))", "note": "cram_dopen parses the CRAM file definition and calls cram_read_SAM_hdr to decode the SAM header block, which contains the attacker-controlled compressed data."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "cram/cram_io.c", "function": "cram_read_SAM_hdr", "line": 4627, "var": "b", "code": "if (cram_uncompress_block(b) != 0)", "note": "cram_read_SAM_hdr reads the container and the first block via cram_read_block, then decompresses it with cram_uncompress_block."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "cram/cram_io.c", "function": "cram_read_block", "line": 1445, "var": "b->data", "code": "if (!(b->data = malloc(b->comp_size)))", "note": "cram_read_block allocates a 2-byte heap buffer b->data (comp_size=2) and fills it with the attacker-controlled compressed block bytes 0x29 0x00."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "cram/cram_io.c", "function": "cram_uncompress_block", "line": 1682, "var": "uncomp", "code": "uncomp = (char *)rans_uncompress_4x16(b->data, b->comp_size, &usize2);", "note": "The block method is RANS_PR0, so cram_uncompress_block passes the 2-byte b->data buffer and comp_size=2 to the rANS decoder."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "htscodecs/htscodecs/rANS_static4x16pr.c", "function": "rans_uncompress_4x16", "line": 1805, "var": "in/in_size", "code": "return rans_uncompress_to_4x16(in, in_size, NULL, out_size);", "note": "rans_uncompress_4x16 forwards the 2-byte input buffer (in_size=2) to rans_uncompress_to_4x16."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "htscodecs/htscodecs/rANS_static4x16pr.c", "function": "rans_uncompress_to_4x16", "line": 1536, "var": "in[c_meta_len]", "code": "unsigned int N = in[c_meta_len++];", "note": "in[0]=0x29 has the X_STRIPE (0x08) bit set, so the stripe path runs: c_meta_len starts at 1, var_get_u32(in+1,in_end,&ulen) consumes in[1]=0x00 (1 byte) making c_meta_len=2, then in[2] is read from the 2-byte buffer -> heap-buffer-overflow READ 1."}
]
EOF
